tspan.tspan: Boolean
Statistical
Mechanics
Boolean
Statistical
Mechanics
This text presents research on statistical mechanics of
Boolean-valued random fields. It analyzes the
thermodynamic principles of Boolean random walks, a
generalization of random walks not available in
academic literature. This independently produced
monograph scaffolds motivating examples with 188
figures in a color-blind friendly palette.
This book is ideal for a special topics seminar to
synthesize a complete undergraduate statistics sequence.
Each chapter in Part I briefly covers preliminary
knowledge that learners will need to comprehend
Boolean statistical mechanics. Part II covers original
research in adapting statistical mechanics to analyze
Markov chains of Boolean systems. The philosophy of
Part III tackles the foundations of physics and
mathematics.
This book is for my fellow academics who are tired of
the publish or perish pressures that create short-term
research horizons. Blue skies research like this is
possible when you become brave enough to walk the
road less traveled.
